items.note: Chinese Z2 translates E2+E3 (cut at the comma before 是企业非常珍惜); Z3 translates E4+E5 (cut at the colon).
Chinese Z1 packs E1-E4 (First to Fourth) into one semicolon-separated sentence; cut at the semicolons.

1.text: 积极的企业文化提升员工满意度，员工满意度越高，工作就越出色；工作越出色，客户成果就越好；客户成果越好，服务质量就越好。
1.why: Original renders 'improved client outcomes' as 顾客就越多 (more customers), which is not what the English says.

5.text: 对于3M而言，这就是便利贴。
5.why: Original 这种企业文化就是自己的身份标签 does not translate 'it was the Post-it note'; the English names the Post-it note as the blockbuster product.
